pois.name: Phare de La Revellata
pois.intro: Le phare de la Revellata, aussi appelé phare du golfe de Calvi, balise la côte nord-ouest de l'île française de Corse, du golfe de Galéria aux côtes des Agriates.

pois.name: Cathédrale Saint-Jean-Baptiste
pois.intro: Calvi Cathedral is a former Roman Catholic church located in Calvi on the island of Corsica, France. It was the episcopal seat of the Bishop of Sagona, which in 1801 was succeeded by the Bishopric of Ajaccio.

pois.name: Tour du sel
pois.intro: The Tower of Calvi is a Genoese tower in the commune of Calvi on the Corsica. The tower was one of a series of coastal defences built by the Republic of Genoa between 1530 and 1620 to stem the attacks by Barbary pirates.

pois.name: Exposition du 2ème Régiment Etranger de Parachutistes
Tour de Caldanu
pois.intro: The Tower of Caldanu is a ruined Genoese tower located in the commune of Lumio on the west coast of Corsica. The tower was built in the second half of the 16th century.

pois.name: Centre de conservation préventive des objets mobiliers
Oratoire Saint-Antoine
pois.intro: L'Oratoire Saint-Antoine er et kapell i byen Calvi på Korsika. Kappelet ble bygget mellom 1510 og 1513 og det ble gjort restaureringsarbeid på kirken i 2006.

pois.name: Tour génoise de Spano
pois.intro: The Tower of Spanu is a ruined Genoese tower located in the commune of Lumio on the west coast of the Corsica. It sits on the Punta Spano headland at a height of 25 metres above the sea.

pois.name: Chapelle Saint-Pierre-Saint-Paul
pois.intro: Die romanisch-pisanische Kirche San Pietro e Paolo befindet sich abseits der Ortschaft, auf dem alten Friedhof von Lumio im Nordwesten der Insel Korsika. Der ungegliederte einschiffige Bau aus der zweiten Hälfte des 11.

pois.name: Port de Calvi
pois.intro: Le port de Calvi est un port de plaisance du golfe de Calvi, à Calvi, en Corse.
